ValidationRule.description: If a Task is assigned to the Systems Queue, or the Task Template indicates it will be assigned there, only members of the Systems Queue can change the status to Completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), NOT($Permission.Systems_Task_Approval), OR( Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = "Systems", Task_Template_Queue__c = "Systems" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This task is (or is set to be) assigned to the Systems Queue. Only Systems Queue members can set the status to Completed.
